text.en: Cast by the Qijia culture of the upper Yellow River, this small bronze disc is among the earliest mirrors known in China. Its back carries a seven-point star around a pierced knob, while one face was polished to hold a reflection. Such mirrors accompanied the dead, tying early metallurgy to beliefs about light and the soul.
text.zh: 此镜铸造于黄河上游的齐家文化时期，是中国已知最早的铜镜之一。镜背以穿孔镜钮为中心饰七角星纹，镜面则打磨光亮以照容。此类铜镜多随葬于墓中，将早期冶铸技术与古人关于光明、灵魂的信仰联系在一起。
约公元前2000年 · 青铜 · 青海贵南

text.en: From the Metropolitan Museum, this small mirror is built in two layers: a Warring States openwork plaque of interlaced dragons, confirmed as period, set before a plain backing plate the museum notes may be a later replacement. Both layers are modelled separately in the viewer.
text.zh: 此镜藏于大都会艺术博物馆，为双层结构：战国时期蟠螭纹透雕饰片（馆方确认为原物）置于素面镜体之前，而后方镜体可能为后世配补。观赏器已将两层分离建模，可转动细看。

text.en: China · Warring States (openwork) · Bronze · The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 23.120.5
text.zh: 中国 · 战国（透雕层） · 青铜 · 大都会艺术博物馆 23.120.5

text.en: The type made famous by Wu Hung's reading of it as a cosmic diagram: the T, L and V marks trace the liubo game board and the square Bright Hall, while the four spirits — dragon, tiger, bird and tortoise-snake — guard the cardinal points around the central knob and its twelve nipples.
text.zh: 即巫鸿所释的“宇宙图式”之镜：T、L、V 纹对应博局与明堂方院，青龙、白虎、朱雀、玄武四神分守四方，环绕中央镜钮与十二乳钉，把天地秩序铸于镜背。

text.en: Han dynasty, 206 BCE–220 CE · Bronze · The Metropolitan Museum of Art
text.zh: 汉代 公元前206–公元220 · 青铜 · 大都会艺术博物馆

text.en: Excavated in 2002 from the Tang tomb of Yan Zhi and his wife at Majiagou, Baqiao, Xi'an, this eight-lobed mirror is a masterpiece of gold-backed casting. Its repoussé gold shell shows eight beasts among scrolling vines, grapes and birds spilling across the lobes — Central Asian motifs meeting Chinese craft on the Silk Road.
text.zh: 2002年出土于西安灞桥马家沟唐代阎智与夫人裴氏合葬墓。镜作八出菱花形，背贴锤揲金壳：内区八只瑞兽攀枝嬉戏，外区葡萄藤蔓与禽鸟过梁缠绕，是丝绸之路将西域葡萄纹与中原铸镜工艺融于一镜的巅峰之作。

text.en: Tang dynasty, 618–907 · Gold & bronze · Xi'an Museum
text.zh: 唐代 618–907 · 金背铜镜 · 西安博物院

text.en: From the British Museum collection, this Song-dynasty bronze mirror is cast with a deity mounted on a deer amid clouds and waves, a long handle extending from the rim so it could be held or hung. Turn it in the viewer to follow the rider across the lively, crowded ground of the back.
text.zh: 此镜为大英博物馆藏宋代铜镜，镜背铸仙人骑鹿、云气涌动，镜缘伸出长柄，可执可悬。请在观赏器中缓缓转动，跟随骑鹿仙人穿行于繁密生动的纹饰之间。

text.en: China · Song dynasty · Bronze · British Museum, 1990,0531.8
text.zh: 中国 · 宋代 · 青铜 · 大英博物馆 1990,0531.8

text.en: A late-Qing hand mirror from the Palace Museum: a bronze disc covered in translucent cobalt-blue enamel, painted with gilt double-happiness characters and the Eight Treasures, set on a matching enamelled handle. Hold it in the viewer as it was once held in the hand.
text.zh: 此镜为北京故宫博物院藏清晚期把镜：铜胎施透明蓝珐琅，描金双喜字与八宝纹，下接同饰珐琅长柄。请在观赏器中拿起它，如百年前一样对镜执照。

text.en: China · Late Qing dynasty · Enamel on bronze · The Palace Museum, Beijing, 00180346
text.zh: 中国 · 清晚期 · 铜胎珐琅 · 北京故宫博物院 故00180346
